body.message:
Good morning

We have received the reservation from you however please note that We attempted to collect the payment through Booking.com, but unfortunately, it didn’t go through.

As an alternative, we can share a secure payment link with you. Once the payment is completed, your booking will be confirmed. At the moment, it remains unconfirmed due to the pending payment.

Please let us know if you’d like us to send the link.
